name: Min An
tags-ch: 互動設計&高仿真互動原型
使用者體驗研究與人本設計
summary-en: Senior UI/UX Designer with 5+ years of experience specializing in complex financial products and cross-border product development. Equipped with front-end technical skills, I champion DesignOps practices by building standardized Design Systems that improve cross-team collaboration efficiency.

My core strength lies in end-to-end UX research and UI execution — using NPS, Kano models, and GA insights to define requirements, and applying service blueprints to untangle complex online-to-offline experiences. I have led WCAG accessibility optimizations and B2B/B2C SaaS platform redesigns, driving key decisions through usability testing.

I see myself as more than a designer — I'm an advocate for product value. I've hold multiple Design workshops that improved cross-team collaboration efficiency by 30%. I stay data-driven to ensure every design decision solves a real user pain point while delivering measurable business value and conversion growth.
summary-ch: 擁有 6+ 年 UI/UX 設計經驗，有經手高複雜度金融產品與跨國數位產品的端到端體驗設計經驗。面對需求持續變動、多方利害關係人觀點並存的高模糊度環境，能快速釐清方向、建立清楚架構，將使用者、商業與技術需求整合為清晰且可執行的方案。
具備完整 UX Research 與 UI Design 的執行能力，運用 NPS、Kano 模型、GA 與易用性測試進行需求洞察與設計驗證，並以服務藍圖梳理大型、跨系統的線上線下服務流程。曾執行過 WCAG 無障礙設計與跨國產品規劃，透過清楚的設計文件與論述，協助團隊與利害關係人對齊設計決策。對各種設計方法與 AI 輔助設計工具保持好奇，持續將新方法導入設計流程。
有前端開發能力，並有 Design System 建置經驗，曾建立標準化 Figma Library，提升跨部門協作效率與產品體驗一致性；也主辦過 UI/UX Workshop，帶動跨部門設計共識，合作效率成長 30%。

experience.company: 國票綜合證券 IBF Securities
bullets-en: Lead experience design and optimization for 任我贏, a stock trading app, designing the features including dividend tracking, price alerts, and so on — continuously iterating from information architecture and user flows through to interface design.
Focus on the core user base aged 45–64 with fewer knowledge for financial jargon, continuously refining information architecture and copywriting to lower the barrier to understanding and use.
Collaborate closely with PMs, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate complex financial rules and workflows into clear, understandable interfaces.
bullets-ch: 負責證券商行動交易 App「任我贏」的體驗設計與優化，範圍涵蓋股利專區、到價通知、借貸借券等核心功能，從資訊架構、操作流程到介面設計都持續迭代改善。
針對 45–64 歲核心客群，找出他們在金融術語與介面理解上的障礙，透過內容設計與流程調整，降低操作與理解門檻。
與 PM、業務及工程團隊協作，在需求持續變動、多方意見並存的情況下，把複雜的金融規則轉譯成清晰、可執行的使用者體驗。

experience.company: 玉山商業銀行 E.SUN COMMERCIAL BANK
bullets-en: Led end-to-end experience design for UCB Mobile Banking App, a large-scale cross-border product — from user research and wireframing through to UI design. Applied NPS, Kano analysis and GA insights to understand user needs, collaborating with regulators in Cambodia, PMs, developers and cross-functional stakeholders to turn complex, fast-changing requirements into actionable digital experiences.

Led experience optimization for both the candidate-facing recruitment platform (B2C) and internal HR system (B2B), mapping the application, hiring and onboarding journey. Used card sorting, user journey analysis and usability testing to identify 8+ key improvement opportunities across roles.

Optimized internal systems aligning WCAG accessibility standards to improve usability for elderly users and those with declining vision. Built a shared, extensible Figma library and design guidelines that improved consistency across large, multi-team projects and streamlined collaboration.

Planned and facilitated 5 internal UI/UX workshops ( including design thinking, user journey mapping and card sorting ) — using clear documentation and rationale to align cross-functional teams around design decisions, improving cross-department collaboration efficiency by 30%.

Designed the design team's official website end-to-end — from content planning and information architecture to front-end build (HTML/CSS/jQuery) — translating the team's work and value into accessible digital content.
bullets-ch: 主導大型跨國產品 UCB Mobile Banking App 端到端體驗設計，從使用者需求洞察、Wireframe 規劃到 UI 設計與體驗優化；運用 NPS、Kano 分析與 GA 洞察需求，並與柬埔寨主管機關、PM、開發團隊及跨職能利害關係人協作，將複雜需求轉化為可執行的數位體驗方案。
主導 B2B/B2C 招募平台與內部招募系統的體驗優化，梳理應徵、招募與新人入職流程，透過 Card Sorting、使用者旅程分析與 Usability Testing 找出 8+ 項關鍵優化機會，改善跨角色的整體服務體驗。
依 WCAG 無障礙設計標準優化內部系統，提升長者及視覺能力退化使用者的可用性；建立可共用、可擴充的 Figma Library 與設計規範，提升大型跨專案的設計一致性與跨部門協作效率。
規劃和主持 5 場 UI/UX 講座與 Workshop，運用 Design Thinking、使用者旅程與 Card Sorting 等方法，向跨部門團隊清楚闡述設計價值與論述，促進跨部門合作效率成長 30%。
設計團隊官方網站，從內容規劃、資訊架構到 HTML/CSS/jQuery 前端切版上線，將團隊的服務與設計價值轉化為易於理解的數位內容。

Planned and designed social media content for 田寮生技數位科技及其子品牌, converting complex biotech information into easy-to-understand visuals and graphic design assets for product promotion, brand identity, and seasonal campaigns.

Partnered with the 5% Design Action social design platform on a project designing an online-to-offline service system, mapping the service process and service blueprint, and planning the app and website architecture.
Designed event posters and recruitment materials, and managed social media, for 小紅樓音樂藝術工作室.
bullets-ch: 參與新加坡新創公司 TicketRecipe 二手票券交易平台（Web）UI/UX 設計，與跨國團隊協作，規劃網站資訊架構與使用者體驗。
為田寮生技數位科技及其子品牌規劃社群內容與視覺設計，將複雜生技資訊轉化為易於理解的視覺內容，支援產品推廣與品牌溝通。
與 5% Design Action 社會設計平台合作，設計整合線上與線下服務的系統，透過服務藍圖梳理服務流程，並規劃 App 與網站架構。
小紅樓音樂藝術工作室各項活動海報、招生文宣設計，及社群媒體營運。
